title: Company-Wise Question Repo — Supplemental Use Only
intro: Resource: github.com/snehasishroy/leetcode-companywise-interview-questions (free, no Premium needed). This is deliberately NOT the primary driver of this plan — patterns come first for all-round readiness. Use this tab only as described below.

rows.how: Skip this tab entirely. Every problem should come from the 8-Week Plan / Problem List tabs.
Open the repo, pick a company folder from your active pipeline, skim the list — solve 2-3 problems you haven't already covered as a pattern-recognition check, not a checklist to clear.
rows.companies: Rotate: Google, Meta, Stripe, Databricks first (Fall 2026 priority); Snowflake, Apple, Nvidia, Nutanix, Cohere, Astranis, Bloomberg, Shopify if time allows (already in your pipeline)
rows.budget: ~15-20% of that week's new problems (see Review Weighting Guide)

rows.when: The moment you have a real interview scheduled
rows.how: Pivot hard: open that specific company's folder, work top-to-bottom through as much of the list as your prep window allows. This is the one time company-repo problems should become primary over patterns.
rows.companies: Whichever company just gave you a date
rows.budget: As much as the timeline demands
